return_contract.project_inputs: same Project/draft identity/base revision and current local unsaved form values; RevisionConflict preserves submitted proposal for explicit reconciliation
return_contract.runtime: same RunInputRef/run_id/confirmed view_time; Back changes parent rows/window/filters only, not production or latest deliberate selected time
return_contract.connections: lost connection stops automatic edits; pending acceptance stays uncertain, last confirmed repair count is shown, no automatic resend/new Run
return_contract.dock: Window menu controls 160px default timeline and separate readonly description dock; tools below; keep current mother baseline

state_expectations.input: initial complete goal + one actual successful Run
state_expectations.expected: show target met, one Run, no required compare; enable selected report/project delivery
one critical missing list; keep draft; no fabricated quantitative or layout Pass

state_expectations.input: arrival field granted, full Scenario candidate secretly changes quality
state_expectations.expected: atomic PermissionDenied; retain all original objects and visible form proposal
show repairs1..3, finite_budget_exhausted and actual shortfall; no fourth automatic repair

state_expectations.input: completed R capture arrives while editor now R+1
state_expectations.expected: old revision label/result stays associated; no replacement of active preview

state_expectations.input: cancel request races completed export or renderer result
state_expectations.expected: actual terminal Completed wins; CancelRequested not success/cancelled; actual files/image only
